BlackRock manages about $1,880 for every human on Earth.

On Sep 30, 2026, BlackRock managed $15.5 trillion of clients' money, from pension funds to everyday savers, per its Q3 results. In those three months alone, clients added $205 billion, about $2.2 billion a day. Split $15.5 trillion across the world's 8.24 billion people (PRB, 2026) and it comes to about $1,880 each.

Did you know your pension or index fund might be managed by a company you've never thought about?

Sources: BlackRock Q3 2026 results (Oct 14, 2026), PRB 2026 World Population Data Sheet. Not financial advice.
